TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "shipments 表有 carrier、shipped_ts、delivered_ts，可以用來算配送天數。先確認 carrier 的實際值（是否為「順豐」或英文代碼）以及時間欄位的格式。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped, MIN(delivered_ts) AS min_delivered, MAX(delivered_ts) AS max_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC"}}

response: {"thought": "順豐對應 carrier = 'sf'。以出貨日（shipped_ts）落在 2025 年上半年為樣本，計算配送天數並檢查負值與空值。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_negative, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'sf' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'", "SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 2) AS avg_days_valid, COUNT(*) AS n_valid FROM (SELECT julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts) AS d FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'sf' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND delivered_ts >= shipped_ts)"]}}
